claim: Security doctrine: Deny by default, untrusted by construction, plan before power, degrade safely.
Prompt injection controls: Role isolation (separate hashing), quoted-content boxing (verbatim fences), policy-prefix pinning (signed prelude), detector ensemble (pattern+LM).
Tool sandboxes: Per-tool containers with network egress allowlists, read-only FS, CPU/mem/time quotas, syscall filters.
Capability tokens (CapTok): Signed JWT/JWP with claims (sub, act, res, lim, exp, aud, jti), runtime enforcement via sidecar.
Differential Privacy (DP): Event DP for telemetry (ε budgets per tenant/user/feature), Report DP for metrics (Laplace/Gaussian noise), SEG nodes store (ε, δ, mech, scope).
Multi-stage redaction: Ingest (classify/mask secrets/PII), Index (embeddings on redacted content), Render (re-apply by audience/purpose).
κ-gating & abstention: Compute risk = f(injection_score, PII_score, UQ, budget_drift), if risk ≥ κ: abstain (rationale+remediation), contain (downgrade capabilities), or route to HITL.
SSRF defense: URL normalizer (reject non-HTTP(S), IP literals, private ranges), egress policy (proxy with hostname pinning, TLS enforcement), DNS hardening (single trusted resolver).
Supply chain security: SBOM + license allowlist gates, sigstore/SLSA provenance on artifacts, policy packs (banned APIs, dangerous patterns), CI secrets broker (short-lived OIDC tokens).
Guardrails-as-code: Encoded at plan, step, and tool levels in ACL snippets, all checks emit witness events (VIF), integrated with APOE/ACL execution.
